summary: Duke Robotics Corp. filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing that its board approved the appointment of Avi Levin as Chief Financial Officer effective October 1, 2026, with incumbent CFO Shlomo Zakai ceasing service the same day. The company entered into a personal employment agreement providing a gross monthly base salary of NIS 52,250 (about $17,227), a NIS 2,500 monthly expense allowance, and eligibility for an annual bonus up to eight monthly salaries, plus a future grant of options for up to 35,000 shares. No board recommendation or advisor was named, and no deal terms were stated.
